name: Gavin's Naze
summary: Gavin's Naze is the easternmost and most heavily defended of the four promontories overlooking Hillsbrad Foothills. Currently fortified by the dwarven Stormpike clan, the hilltop serves as a forward assembly depot for devastating siege engines aimed directly at the Forsaken in Silverpine and Tirisfal.

sections.title: Stormpike Staging Ground
sections.body: Rising as the easternmost finger of the hills, Gavin's Naze provides the Alliance a commanding vantage point over the lower plains of Hillsbrad Foothills. Dwarven engineers and infantry from the Stormpike clan have heavily fortified the crest, transforming what was once a rugged haven for mountain lions into an active open-air workshop and munitions depot. Here, dwarven craftsmen assemble and maintain siege engines, intending to roll them against the Forsaken once the order is given. The site remains a constant flashpoint of sabotage and border warfare as Horde scouts attempt to disrupt the heavy artillery before it can be unleashed.

faq.answer: The hill is occupied and fortified by the Stormpike clan, an Alliance-aligned dwarven expedition. They have stationed soldiers, sentries, and engineers atop the rise to protect their heavy artillery.

faq.q: What are the dwarves building on the hill?
faq.answer: Stormpike engineers use the hill to assemble heavy dwarven siege engines. These war machines are being prepped to advance against the Forsaken territories to the north and west.

faq.q: What wildlife used to live here?
faq.answer: Before the Stormpike military encampment displaced them, mountain lions prowled these rocky heights, including a rare and uniquely colored beast known to prowl the ridge named Araga.

faq.q: Why does the Horde target this outpost?
faq.answer: The Forsaken and their Horde allies cannot tolerate fully operational dwarven siege engines stationed right above their supply lines. Horde operatives regularly strike the hill with goblin-engineered explosives to sabotage the machinery and dismantle the camp before the artillery can move out.

angles.text: For the dwarves of the Stormpike expedition, this fortified hill is a crucial staging ground to assemble siege engines and defend Alliance interests across Lordaeron.
The dwarven war machines on this ridge pose a direct threat to the Forsaken, making sabotage of the workshop an urgent priority.
